credits.title: Dear Ajayi
credits.overview: In 1990s Nigeria, two estranged sisters forced to live under the same roof while caring for their paralysed mother navigate grief, ambition, love, and the fragile bonds of family.

credits.title: The Other Side of the Bridge
credits.overview: A former teenage boxing champion returns to the ring to save his trainer’s gym, facing a rival from a different part of Lagos.

credits.title: Osamede
credits.overview: In the Benin Empire of 1897, an orphan girl discovers she holds the power of the sacred Aruosa stone. As the Oba faces British conquest and betrayal from within, she must embrace her destiny to save the kingdom.

credits.title: Dead Tide
credits.overview: After losing his sister, Itoro seeks a peaceful life by the beach, but his when Sade mistakenly films the president's son Dare committing murder and finds refuge in Itoro's bar, he must outsmart their pursuers and seek justice.

credits.title: The Fire and the Moth
credits.overview: Violence and mayhem ensue after a smuggler escapes with a rare Ife bronze head into a gritty western Nigerian town.

credits.title: A Green Fever
credits.overview: Things get unnerving when a suave realtor and his sick daughter take refuge in a mysterious mansion after a medical emergency in the middle of nowhere.

credits.title: Cordelia
credits.overview: Adapted from the eponymous novel by Nigerian author and poet Femi Osofisan, Cordelia is a romantic period-drama where romance meets politics. credits.title: Love Is War
credits.overview: Love is war is an intense drama about a husband and wife battling for governorship of Ondo State.

credits.title: 93 Days
credits.overview: Bimbo Akintola, Danny Glover and TIFF Rising Star Somkele Iyamah-Idhalama star in director Steve Gukas’ riveting real-life thriller about courageous health-care workers in Lagos battling the Ebola outbreak of 2014.
